cond_0001.intro:
As a Pricing Analyst II, you'll work closely with sales representatives, product solutions consultants, legal, contract administration, business unit owners, billing and finance to generate and prepare pricing proposals for delivery to clients.
The Pricing Support team provides pricing for our Banking Solutions products using our home-grown [Product name masked] currently. We work collaboratively with many groups in the organization daily including our primary client, Sales. The team currently processes an average of 2,300 requests per month with a team of 3 Analysts.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Collaborates with sales executives and relationship managers, product managers and senior management to provide pricing information in support of pricing strategies, policies and recommendations.
Obtains feedback on pricing recommendation from [Company name masked] internal clients to create updates to proposals and/or process.
Ensures corporate and divisional guidelines are in compliance with company standards.
Prepares and provides pricing proposals for sales executives and relationship managers.
Recommends pricing adjustments that will support business objectives and plans and will not hinder ability to capture future value.
Routinely reviews pricing proposals for quality assurance based on department standards as related to discounts and credits.
Creates and recommends new product pricing enhancements affecting entire client base.
Acts as a liaison with sales and product consultants regarding pricing adjustments.
Creates and maintains secured electronic price lists.
Tests functionality of pricing generator new releases.
Participates in Beta releases and coordinates recommended changes based on outcome.
Assists sales with training development as it relates to sales proposal requests and/or process orientation.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance or business administration or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience.
2+ Years of pricing experience.
Sound knowledge of pricing strategy with an emphasis on value-based concepts including economic value analysis, role of costs in pricing decisions, segmented pricing approaches, life cycle pricing concepts, best practice negotiation strategies, pricing psychology, price sensitivity factors and measurement techniques, financial analysis including breakeven sales calculations and margin analysis and the role of competition.
Strong analytical, statistical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to analyze and solve problems using learned techniques and tools.
Good understanding of financial concepts.
Attention to detail, accuracy and confidentiality.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of management (internally/externally), employees, clients and public.
Preferred Requirements
Strong understanding of [Company name masked] business strategy and how products or initiatives contribute to [Company name masked] goals.
General business skills, industry knowledge, financial management and planning skills.
Ability to understand and apply learned concepts.
Ability to utilize judgment in decision making process and decisions related to job tasks.
Strong organizational skills and ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Exceptional interpersonal skills: establishing personal and professional relationships among diverse internal and external publics.
Flexibility, versatility, dependability.
Communicates ideas both verbally and in written form in a clear, concise and professional manner.
Working knowledge of PowerPoint for presentation creation.
Ability to create process and procedure documentation for training and publishing to internal sites.
Knowledge of Oracle CPQ is a plus.

The Pricing Support team provides pricing for our Banking Solutions products using our home-grown [Product name masked] currently. We work collaboratively with many groups in the organization daily including our primary client, Sales. The team currently processes an average of 2,300 requests per month with a team of 3 Analysts. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of pricing structures and how they apply to different client scenarios.
cond_0310.responsibilities: Collaborates with sales executives and relationship managers, product managers and senior management to provide pricing information in support of pricing strategies, policies and recommendations. Obtains feedback on pricing recommendation from [Company name masked] internal clients to create updates to proposals and/or process. Ensures corporate and divisional guidelines are in compliance with company standards. Prepares and provides pricing proposals for sales executives and relationship managers. Recommends pricing adjustments that will support business objectives and plans and will not hinder ability to capture future value. Routinely reviews pricing proposals for quality assurance based on department standards as related to discounts and credits. Creates and recommends new product pricing enhancements affecting entire client base. Acts as a liaison with sales and product consultants regarding pricing adjustments. Creates and maintains secured electronic price lists. Tests functionality of pricing generator new releases. Participates in Beta releases and coordinates recommended changes based on outcome. Assists sales with training development as it relates to sales proposal requests and/or process orientation.
cond_0310.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance or business administration or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience
2+ Years of pricing experience
Sound knowledge of pricing strategy with an emphasis on value-based concepts including economic value analysis, role of costs in pricing decisions, segmented pricing approaches, life cycle pricing concepts, best practice negotiation strategies, pricing psychology, price sensitivity factors and measurement techniques, financial analysis including breakeven sales calculations and margin analysis and the role of competition
Strong analytical, statistical and problem-solving skills
Ability to analyze and solve problems using learned techniques and tools
Good understanding of financial concepts
Attention to detail, accuracy and confidentiality
Strong organizational skills and ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of management (internally/externally), employees, clients and public
Preferred Requirements
Strong understanding of [Company name masked] business strategy and how products or initiatives contribute to [Company name masked] goals
General business skills, industry knowledge, financial management and planning skills
Ability to understand and apply learned concepts
Ability to utilize judgment in decision making process and decisions related to job tasks
Exceptional interpersonal skills: establishing personal and professional relationships among diverse internal and external publics
Communicates ideas both verbally and in written form in a clear, concise and professional manner
Flexibility, versatility, dependability
Working knowledge of PowerPoint for presentation creation
Ability to create process and procedure documentation for training and publishing to internal sites
Knowledge of Oracle CPQ is a plus
cond_0310.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.
cond_0310.workplace_support: We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects society through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, and inclusive benefits. We want employees from different backgrounds to feel supported and able to thrive.

As a Pricing Analyst II, you'll work closely with sales representatives, product solutions consultants, legal, contract administration, business unit owners, billing and finance to generate and prepare pricing proposals for delivery to clients.

Background in [Company name masked] business strategy and how products or initiatives contribute to organizational goals.

The Pricing Support team provides pricing for Banking Solutions products using [Product name masked]. We work collaboratively with many groups in the organization daily including our primary client, Sales. The team currently processes an average of 2,300 requests per month with a team of 3 Analysts. Most people become stronger in this kind of pricing work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0527.responsibilities:
Collaborates with sales executives and relationship managers, product managers and senior management to provide pricing information in support of pricing strategies, policies and recommendations.
Obtains feedback on pricing recommendation from internal clients to create updates to proposals and/or process.
Ensures corporate and divisional guidelines are in compliance with company standards.
Prepares and provides pricing proposals for sales executives and relationship managers.
Recommends pricing adjustments that will support business objectives and plans and will not hinder ability to capture future value.
Routinely reviews pricing proposals for quality assurance based on department standards as related to discounts and credits.
Creates and recommends new product pricing enhancements affecting entire client base.
Acts as a liaison with sales and product consultants regarding pricing adjustments.
Creates and maintains secured electronic price lists.
Tests functionality of pricing generator new releases.
Participates in Beta releases and coordinates recommended changes based on outcome.
Assists sales with training development as it relates to sales proposal requests and/or process orientation.
cond_0527.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance or business administration or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience.
2+ Years of pricing experience.
Sound knowledge of pricing strategy with an emphasis on value-based concepts including economic value analysis, role of costs in pricing decisions, segmented pricing approaches, life cycle pricing concepts, best practice negotiation strategies, pricing psychology, price sensitivity factors and measurement techniques, financial analysis including breakeven sales calculations and margin analysis and the role of competition.
Strong analytical, statistical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to analyze and solve problems using learned techniques and tools.
Attention to detail, accuracy and confidentiality.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of management (internally/externally), employees, clients and public.
Communicates ideas both verbally and in written form in a clear, concise and professional manner.
Preferred Requirements
Strong understanding of [Company name masked] business strategy and how products or initiatives contribute to organizational goals.
General business skills, industry knowledge, financial management and planning skills.
Good understanding of financial concepts.
Ability to understand and apply learned concepts.
Ability to utilize judgment in decision making process and decisions related to job tasks.
Strong organizational skills and ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Exceptional interpersonal skills: establishing personal and professional relationships among diverse internal and external publics.
Flexibility, versatility, dependability.
Working knowledge of PowerPoint for presentation creation.
Ability to create process and procedure documentation for training and publishing to internal sites.
Knowledge of Oracle CPQ is a plus.

As a Pricing Analyst II, you'll work closely with sales representatives, product solutions consultants, legal, contract administration, business unit owners, billing and finance to generate and prepare pricing proposals for delivery to clients.
The Pricing Support team provides pricing for Banking Solutions products using [Product name masked]. We work collaboratively with many groups in the organization daily including our primary client, Sales. The team currently processes an average of 2,300 requests per month with a team of 3 Analysts. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of pricing structures and how they apply to different client scenarios.
cond_0625.responsibilities:
Collaborates with sales executives and relationship managers, product managers and senior management to provide pricing information in support of pricing strategies, policies and recommendations.
Obtains feedback on pricing recommendation from internal clients to create updates to proposals and/or process.
Ensures corporate and divisional guidelines are in compliance with company standards.
Prepares and provides pricing proposals for sales executives and relationship managers.
Recommends pricing adjustments that will support business objectives and plans and will not hinder ability to capture future value.
Routinely reviews pricing proposals for quality assurance based on department standards as related to discounts and credits.
Creates and recommends new product pricing enhancements affecting entire client base.
Acts as a liaison with sales and product consultants regarding pricing adjustments.
Creates and maintains secured electronic price lists.
Tests functionality of pricing generator new releases.
Participates in Beta releases and coordinates recommended changes based on outcome.
Assists sales with training development as it relates to sales proposal requests and/or process orientation.
cond_0625.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance or business administration or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience.
2+ Years of pricing experience.
Communicates ideas both verbally and in written form in a clear, concise and professional manner.
Strong understanding of business strategy and how products or initiatives contribute to company goals.
A sound knowledge of pricing strategy with an emphasis on value-based concepts including economic value analysis, role of costs in pricing decisions, segmented pricing approaches, life cycle pricing concepts, best practice negotiation strategies, pricing psychology, price sensitivity factors and measurement techniques, financial analysis including breakeven sales calculations and margin analysis and the role of competition.
General business skills, industry knowledge, financial management and planning skills.
Ability to analyze and solve problems using learned techniques and tools.
Strong analytical, statistical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to understand and apply learned concepts.
Ability to utilize judgment in decision making process and decisions related to job tasks.
Strong organizational skills and ability to handle multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
Exceptional interpersonal skills: establishing personal and professional relationships among diverse internal and external publics.
Good understanding of financial concepts.
Attention to detail, accuracy and confidentiality.
Flexibility, versatility, dependability.
Requires the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all levels of management (internally/externally), employees, clients and public.
Working knowledge of PowerPoint for presentation creation.
Ability to create process and procedure documentation for training and publishing to internal sites.
Knowledge of Oracle CPQ is a plus.
cond_0625.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
